mapper.sql: ct.id, ct.course_id, ct.weekday, ct.start_period, ct.end_period, ct.start_week, ct.end_week, ct.room_id, c.course_code as courseCode, c.course_name as courseName, c.teacher_id as teacherId, c.term as term, c.max_student as maxStudent, t.teacher_name as teacherName, r.room_name as roomName, r.capacity as roomCapacity
from class_time ct join course c on ct.course_id = c.id left join teacher t on c.teacher_id = t.teacher_id left join room r on ct.room_id = r.id
